a2.new_text:
Having to pay for a redelivery just doesn’t feel right to me. My husband and I are both away at work. So, when we can choose a delivery time, we choose a day and time when we know we’ll be home. But once, I chose a morning time, and the package did not come.

I went out to do an errand. When I came back, there was a note saying they had tried to deliver it. There are also many packages where we cannot choose a time. We do not know when they will come, either. Before they charge us, I want them to fix two things: come at the time we chose and tell us when the package will arrive.

Delivery workers must have a hard time because there are not enough of them. I guess it can’t be helped. But I can’t accept having to pay for that. Am I wrong to feel this way?

Having to pay for redelivery just doesn’t sit right with me. My husband and I are both away at work, so for packages where we can choose a delivery time, we choose a day and time when we know we’ll be home. But once, I chose a morning time slot and the package didn’t come.

I went out to take care of an errand, and when I got back, there was a missed-delivery notice. There are also many packages where you can’t choose a time, and you don’t know beforehand when they’ll arrive. Before charging us, I want them to first do something about arriving at the time we chose and telling us when the package will arrive.

The delivery workers must have a hard time because there aren’t enough of them, and I guess it can’t be helped. But I can’t accept having to pay for that. Am I wrong to feel this way?
